descriptionChirho: To abandon, desert, or leave behind a person, particularly in their time of need, whether by God or by humans (Matt 27:46; Mark 15:34; 2 Tim 4:10,16; Rom 9:29; Acts 2:27,31; Heb 13:5).
To abandon or neglect the practice of assembling together, a specific application of forsaking directed at communal gathering rather than a person (Heb 10:25).
